caution_findings.note: Packet database snapshot contains DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows but no packet sequence rows. Merged all_sequences.csv and primary Table S1 were reopened to verify sequence identity. No APD6 or DRAMP rows are linked to this DOI in the packet manifest.
DBAASPS_10589 uses database name Modified Clavanin A; primary source calls the same FLPII-tagged peptide clavanin-MO.
Clavanin A is natural-origin from Styela clava, but this paper assayed synthesized Clavanin A and clavanin-MO; both facts are preserved.
Figure 1 was locally opened and supports low toxicity/cell-viability context. Exact DBAASP toxicity values were preserved from linked rows and not newly digitized from the image.
Direct mechanism is limited to immune-modulation assays. Antibacterial activity remains phenotype-supported; membrane and ppGpp data do not define the killing target.
Supplement text/captions were recovered from the OA package DOC. Supplement figure panels embedded in the DOC were not numerically digitized, so figure-only exact values are not asserted.
LL-37, gentamicin, and imipenem Table 1 control columns were reviewed as assay context but not promoted to current-paper DBAASP AMP database records.
